title: BroodMinder Weight Failure Rate
dataSources: Beehive telemetry (`beehive:reading`), coop door (`chickencoop:door`), egg counts (`egg:count`), livestock tags (`livestock:tag`), feed level (`feed:level`), pasture sensors (`pasture:sensor`), trail cams (`trailcam:detection`).
app: Homestead sensors — connected beehive scale/temperature/sound, automatic chicken-coop door, egg counter, livestock GPS/health tags, feed-silo level, and pasture soil sensors — via MQTT and LoRaWAN gateways.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=broodminder:weight
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(sensor_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by hive_id
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often BroodMinder weight records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each hive.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize sensor_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per hive.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It scores which parts of your BroodMinder weight data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
